wt_insilico.note: WT seq in the mutant's ORDERED backbone (C/6 ASP->GLY). HARD negative for ELECTROSTATIC/direct designs only; BIASED (false-non-selective) for CONFORMATIONAL designs -> use the floppy WT ensemble for those. See wt_negative_policy.

binder_hotspots.note: do NOT target directly; read via bulge geometry + electrostatics

wt_negative_policy.ordered_chemistry_negative: wt_insilico.pdb -- WT seq in the mutant ORDERED backbone; the HARD negative for ELECTROSTATIC/direct-readout designs (shape identical, only P6 chemistry differs). NEVER the negative for CONFORMATIONAL designs: they SHOULD grip the ordered shape, so frozen-ordered WT reads as false-non-selective -> false reject.
wt_negative_policy.conformational_negative: WT free-peptide-MHC MD ENSEMBLE (TO BUILD) = the floppy states, plus an unbound ordering-penalty term ddG_order(WT vs G12D). The correct negative for CONFORMATIONAL/gated designs.
wt_negative_policy.cofold_from_seq: Boltz/Chai fold WT from SEQUENCE (not from wt_insilico.pdb) -> one pose, likely ordered-bulge-like -> UNDER-captures WT floppiness; treat as complementarity-only.
wt_negative_policy.rule: Score each design's g12d-wt gap against the HARDEST WT negative applicable to its mechanism; a maximally-robust design clears ALL (ordered-chemistry AND floppy-ensemble).
